_comment: Approval manifest controlled by the CONSUMER (the Processing Service's build), not by the supplier of the external dependency. Experiment A: the build/installation phase verifies a candidate wheel against this manifest before it is installed; a wheel with the right name+version but different content (different sha256) is rejected even though its filename/version look identical to the approved one. Regenerate the digest with: python -m hashlib... or just `shasum -a 256 <wheel>`; scripts/build_packages.sh prints it after building.
